item.title: Energy bills are forecast to rise by £443 a year from January
item.body: Fresh forecasts suggest household energy bills will jump by 26% in January, adding £443 a year. Inflation is likely to keep rising as a result.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | ⚡ Energy bills are forecast to rise by £443 a year from January

Fresh forecasts suggest household energy bills will jump by 26% in January, adding £443 a year. Inflation is likely to keep rising as a result.

Source: BBC | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 18 November, 10:50
